clips.text: On one H one hundred, Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe turns recorded speech into text, speaker tags, and word timings.

Here is the actual model response. Each word carries a start and end time, and speaker turns stay visible. This original conversation was synthesized locally for a repeatable test. The film compresses the timeline, while the transcript preserves the recording's timing. Inspect every detail in the live viewer.
Search the transcript to find a phrase and jump to its place in the recording. Click a word to hear that moment.
Those same word timestamps can be grouped into subtitle cues and exported as an SRT file. The result stays linked to the exact audio used for this run.
The output is real. Names and speaker turns still deserve a human listen. Raw response and model revision are saved.
